outcome: developmental trajectories of toddlers' emotional and behavioral problems
cohort: 258 mothers and their children followed from birth to 30 months of age
finding: Children's gender, maternal education, infant rearing attitudes, emergency caesarean section, quality of the relationship with the partner, and maternal self-efficacy were predictive of the developmental trajectories of emotional and behavioral problems in toddlers.
mod_finding: Emergency caesarean section, along with child's gender, maternal age and education, relationship quality with partner, and maternal self-efficacy, predicted membership in groups with high and increasing behavioral problems.
